source: hand-read from the scan, page 2 name column
caution: Read by eye from a cursive hand and may itself contain errors, particularly on the surnames. It exists because the only ground truth in this repository was a *typed* page, which hid how the engine behaves on the handwritten majority of the corpus.
note_rows: The engine numbers every detected band; rows 1-3 are the header and its rules, so name i of this list is row first_row + i.
